args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified in all regions.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of actions:
- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with a 0.18 error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the last healthy production release.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions — verified `rolled_out`/`VERIFIED`.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the failure and the rollback.
